summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py with thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) initialised in __init__ and set/cleared in the run_app coroutine's try/finally inside App.run. Added CallThreadReturnType TypeVar. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 9 tests covering not-running, same-thread, widget access, awaitable callables, timeout-class exception propagation, variadic and keyword forwarding, exit value, and call after stop. All 9 pass on Python 3.9 with PYTHONPATH pointing at the repo's src (the venv otherwise imports the shared base/src tree). Full suite (excluding snapshot, cli, devtools, which fail to collect due to missing deps): 68 failures, identical to a clean HEAD export, so no regressions. Nothing committed. Snapshot tests not run.
